title: Senior Manager, Inside Sales
description:
About Us

Odeko is the all-in-one operations and technology partner to more than 20,000 independent coffee shops, cafes and other food establishments.

Through the Odeko web portal and mobile app, customers can purchase supplies from hundreds of national and local brands, track ordering trends, finance equipment, and access insurance. Customers that use Odeko can increase their revenue, reduce their environmental footprint, and save significantly on their cost of goods and time spent on vendor management.

Odeko is on a mission to continuously develop technology to champion your neighborhood cafes, coffee shops, and other independent F&B establishments.

Local coffee shops and cafes are the backbone of any given community, and we’re here to help manage the day-to-day tasks with a platform so intuitive, it’s kinda like magic.

The Odeko team is diverse, passionate, and innovative. Our 400+ employees are spread across numerous departments and business lines, but are single-minded in our mission to develop technology to support the many needs of our customers. We believe that small businesses need support now more than ever, and that Odeko is uniquely positioned to provide that support.

This is a new, foundational role on the Revenue team. The Senior Manager, Inside Sales will own a large, multi-market portfolio of smaller-revenue, single-location accounts - customers who don’t currently warrant a dedicated field relationship, but whose retention, growth, and category adoption still matter significantly to Odeko ’s business. This person is accountable for keeping those customers engaged, growing, and clear on why they chose Odeko in the first place, entirely through remote, scalable, market-aware communication - not in-person visits.
This role is not about saying yes to every customer request. It's about building real customer intimacy at scale: knowing which accounts and moments deserve investment, running a proactive (not reactive) selling motion, and using judgment about what's right for the account and for Odeko 's margin. Because the portfolio spans many warehouse markets with meaningfully different customer profiles and buying patterns, a single national playbook won't work - this role will need to build and adapt market-specific strategies rather than a one-size-fits-all program.
This is a build role first: you'll stand up the segmentation, cadence, tooling, and playbooks for this function as an individual contributor, with the expectation that it grows into a managed team as the model proves out. You will report directly to the Chief Revenue Officer while this function is being established.
Key Responsibilities

• Own end-to-end retention and growth accountability for a large, multi-market portfolio of single-location accounts - without in-person coverage.

• Design and run market-specific communication and engagement strategies, recognizing that the right cadence, channel, and message vary meaningfully by warehouse market.

• Continuously segment the portfolio to concentrate time and program investment on the accounts and moments with the clearest ROI, rather than treating every account identically.

• Build and execute proactive selling motions - category expansion, cross-sell, adoption campaigns - distinct from reactive order-taking or default agreement to every customer ask.

• Surface recurring market-level needs, objections, and competitive signals to Market Operations and Marketing so upstream teams can act on patterns, not just individual cases.

• Partner with Marketing Communications to build always-on and campaign-based touchpoints (email, in-app, SMS) that reinforce the value Odeko delivers and why customers chose us.

• Partner with Market Operations and in-field Market Managers to keep account ownership clean as customers move between this portfolio and field coverage, and to escalate cases the segmentation model misses.

• Build the operating cadence, tooling, and reporting infrastructure for this function

Anduril is seeking a Mechanical Design Engineer to join the Maneuver Dominance team in our London office. The Maneuver Dominance (MD) Team at Anduril develops aerial robotic systems designed to operate in large coordinated teams in concert with ground maneuver forces.

Here you will work on core product development for unmanned rotorcraft and complex systems, including but not limited to design and development of a novel payload carriage and release system, analysis and testing of the system and it’s tooling design. • 5+ years in a technical engineering role in a professional aerospace setting, with demonstrated track record of technical excellence, design creativity, collaboration and consensus building, and successful product delivery.

• Experience in NX/Teamcenter and proficiency in CAD software with specific emphasis on rapid concepting and iteration of novel designs.

• Ability to demonstrate technical knowledge in core engineering principles, including fundamental mechanics of composite and metallic materials, design, analysis, testing, and fabrication.

• Understanding of load paths, design practices, and hand calculations to design robust structurally efficient assemblies.

• An excellent communicator, experienced in report writing and the development and delivery of presentations across a range of settings.

• Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.K. security clearance.

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth - personal, professional, and financial - is unmatched.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission - operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today - and we’re just getting started.

ROLE OVERVIEW

We are seeking an Strategic Account Executive to lead commercial growth across the DACH region. This role is responsible for identifying opportunities, managing complex sales cycles, and building long-term relationships within the legal and professional services sector.

This position will play a key role in expanding Harvey’s presence in the DACH region, working cross-functionally to deliver tailored solutions to clients.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

- Deliver against sales targets with a focus on sustainable growth and performance excellence.

- Own and grow a portfolio of named accounts across DACH, driving full-funnel sales activity from prospecting through to commercial negotiation and onboarding.

- Understand client pain points, organisational structure, and buying processes; tailor solutions that align with strategic outcomes.

- Lead high-impact product demos and client meetings that clearly articulate Harvey’s business value and technical capabilities.

- Collaborate cross-functionally with product, legal, engineering, and GTM to inform roadmap and surface client needs.

- Develop deep, long-term relationships with legal, innovation, and executive stakeholders across the region.

- Document learnings, iterate on messaging, and help build scalable processes to accelerate regional growth.

WHAT YOU HAVE

- Minimum 5 years of experience in enterprise B2B SaaS sales, preferably with exposure to AI, legaltech, or vertical software

- Track record of success managing complex sales cycles with multiple stakeholders

- Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain technical products to non-technical audiences

- Interest in the legal industry and a commitment to enhancing knowledge work through technology

- Familiarity with enterprise sales practices in the DACH region

- Self-motivated and results-oriented, with a collaborative approach to working cross-functionally

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION FOR POSTINGS

- Location: Munich

- Work eligibility: Must have valid German work rights; Harvey does not currently offer visa sponsorship for this role

WHAT WE OFFER

- Be part of building something special as a founding member of our DACH team

- Opportunities to work on cross-functional go-to-market initiatives, with a focus on scaling sales strategy and driving revenue growth

description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

As a Salesforce Developer at Anthropic, you will design, build, and maintain the Salesforce platform that powers our Partnerships business: deal registration, partner attribution, co-sell, and cloud marketplace operations. You'll work both autonomously and collaboratively across Revenue Operations, Partnerships, and Finance to translate partner-channel requirements into scalable Apex, Flow, and integration solutions. We are an AI-first systems team, and you'll be expected to use Claude and our in-house AI development tooling as a core part of how you write, review, and ship code, always against our house standards for flexibility, maintainability, and scale.

Key responsibilities

•
Design and build Partnerships infrastructure in Salesforce, including deal registration workflows, channel-conflict detection, partner attribution, and partner account hierarchy

•
Develop and maintain Apex (triggers, services, selectors, batch/queueable), Lightning Web Components, and Flow automation following our house Apex standards and trigger framework

•
Build and own integrations between Salesforce and partner-ecosystem systems such as cloud marketplaces (AWS, GCP, Azure), PRM tools, and middleware

•
Configure partner-facing portals with appropriate sharing, visibility, and license-model design

•
Use Claude and our internal AI development tooling as a first-class part of your build and code-review workflow

•
Partner with Revenue Operations analysts to ensure data-model decisions support downstream partner performance reporting

•
Partner with DevOps on release management for your work: sandbox strategy, source control, peer review, and deployment via SFDX/metadata tooling

•
Ensure appropriate controls, test coverage, and documentation are in place for an effective control environment

•
Operate with ambiguity in a rapidly changing business, resolve problems independently, and propose solutions that scale

Minimum qualifications

•
Hands-on Salesforce development experience (Apex, SOQL, LWC, Flow) in a production org

•
Experience building or maintaining partner/channel functionality in Salesforce: deal registration, partner portals, attribution models, or co-sell opportunity management

•
Experience integrating Salesforce with external platforms via REST/Bulk APIs, middleware (Workato, Mulesoft, or similar), or direct callouts

•
Fluency with SFDX, source-controlled metadata, and a sandbox-to-prod release process with peer review

•
Active use of AI-assisted development tools (Claude, Copilot, Cursor, or similar) as part of how you write and review code, and the ability to speak to how you steer and verify their output

•
Basic SQL skills and comfort working alongside a data warehouse

•
Effective communication with sales, partnerships, finance, and engineering stakeholders

Preferred qualifications

•
Salesforce Platform Developer I and II certifications

•
Advanced Administrator or Application/System Architect certification

•
Deep understanding of Salesforce platform constraints: governor limits, bulkification, sharing and visibility, recursion control

•
Cloud-marketplace integration experience (AWS, GCP, Azure)

•
Familiarity with partner-specific integration platforms such as Workspan

•
Proven experience scaling Salesforce in a high-growth GTM environment
